cell_rule: n>=20 held-out rows and >=5 distinct score values, SD(y_true)>0 - identical to within_pair_score_residual.csv
note: THE PAPER'S CENTRAL STATISTIC. Within each (metal pair, fold) cell, candidate ligands are ranked by each score (safest first), the lowest-risk fraction r retained, and the RMSE of the retained rows divided by that cell's SD(y_true). Cells averaged with equal weight, then folds (mean +/- SD, ddof=1). Because SD is constant inside a cell the retained subset and every rank statistic are identical with or without normalisation; normalisation changes only the cross-pair aggregation weight and the units. A score constant within a cell is UNDEFINED, not zero. random = one permutation per cell, seed 0. yhat_mag = -|y_pred| as risk. No retraining.
